_comment_phase_5_hour_4: Created during Phase 5 / Hour 4. Before this file, the repo had NO eas.json — `eas build` would have failed for lack of a profile. NX-EAS-001 closure.

build._comment_development: Development profile — local dev clients only. Includes the Expo dev tools / debug bridge. Never ship this to the stores.
build._comment_preview: Preview profile — TestFlight / internal Play tracks. Production code path, production Supabase / Stripe TEST keys, internal distribution. Use this for QA before promoting to production.
build._comment_production: Production profile — what ships to the App Store and Google Play. Release build configuration, AAB on Android (required by Play), autoIncrement bumps buildNumber / versionCode automatically so we never collide with a previous submission. ALL EXPO_PUBLIC_* keys MUST be supplied via `eas secret:create` before the first prod build — supabase URL, anon key, Stripe live publishable key, and the Expo project ID.

submit._comment_production_submit: After `eas build --profile production`, run `eas submit --profile production`. App-Store-Connect creds + Google Play service-account JSON must be supplied via `eas credentials` or environment variables — they are NOT committed to this file.
